summary.content:
Today's selection covers 41 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 29 on Artificial Intelligence and 7 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Inside the Elon Musk-OpenAI Trial Courtroom
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, Dark Reading, SecurityWeek, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 29 articles published in the last 24 hours

top.description: The tech leaders, with combined net worths exceeding $670 billion, have brought props to court and traded icy stares as their legal dispute reaches a denouement.
